target_definition: Terminal closed-loan status: Fully Paid = 0; Charged Off / Default = 1. Active/unseasoned loans (Current, Late, In Grace Period) are excluded as censored.
target_prevalence: 19.98% among 1,348,099 closed loans (11.92% of all 2.26M records)
missing_values: Average missingness 31.78% across 151 columns. 47 columns have >80% missing values.
duplicate_rows: 0 exact full duplicate rows across measured samples.
target_leakage_risks: High risk of post-origination leakage in raw columns: 40 post-origination fields (e.g. recoveries, total_pymnt, last_pymnt_d, last_fico_range_high) must be strictly excluded before training.
suitability_notes: Suitable for historical offline research benchmark when post-origination columns are strictly excluded and closed cohort is isolated.
provenance: LendingClub publicly released historical loan data (2007-2018Q4). Archived on Figshare / Kaggle.
license_and_access: Public historical research data; commercial reuse permission not established for this copy.
qualification_reason: Verified historical U.S. consumer lending dataset with established terminal loan outcomes. Validated for offline benchmark; not validated for Indian borrowers.

target_definition: Same as DS001 but artificially truncated at Excel row ceiling (1,048,576 rows).
target_prevalence: Truncated cohort; biased towards older origination years due to truncation.
target_leakage_risks: Same leakage risks as DS001 plus truncation bias.
suitability_notes: Unsuitable: Truncated artifact missing 1,212,126 rows (53.6% of data) due to Excel row limit.
provenance: Excel export/conversion of DS001.
license_and_access: Same as DS001.
qualification_reason: Artificial 1,048,575 row ceiling caused by Excel format limit silently drops >1.2M rows. Redundant and defective relative to DS001.

target_definition: Binary credit card default in October 2005: 1 = Default, 0 = Repaid duly.
duplicate_rows: 0 duplicate rows (ID column is unique; 35 non-ID row duplicates exist in raw data).
target_leakage_risks: Low. ID must be dropped before modeling. All payment history (April-Sept 2005) precedes October 2005 default target.
suitability_notes: Primary verified benchmark dataset for research default classification models.
provenance: Chung Hua University & Department of Information Management, Taiwan (Yeh & Lien, 2009). UCI Machine Learning Repository.
license_and_access: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). Attribution required.
qualification_reason: Complete, verified borrower-level observations with standardized 6-month repayment trajectories and clean next-month default target. Subject to Taiwan geography limitations.

target_definition: Creditworthiness classification: 1 = Good credit (repaid), 2 = Bad credit (default).
target_leakage_risks: Low. Pre-origination demographic, bank account, and credit request attributes.
suitability_notes: Suitable for research modeling, but small sample size (1,000 rows) and categorical codes require one-hot or ordinal encoding.
provenance: Prof. Dr. Hans Hofmann, University of Hamburg, 1994. UCI Machine Learning Repository.
license_and_access: Non-commercial research / educational use. Commercial permission not established.
qualification_reason: High-quality academic credit dataset but restricted by 1994 vintage, German banking framework, 1,000 row sample limit, and unverified commercial license.

target_definition: Creditworthiness classification: 1 = Good credit, 2 = Bad credit.
target_leakage_risks: Low. Pre-encoded integer representation of DS004.
suitability_notes: Numeric encoded alternative to DS004.
provenance: Prof. Dr. Hans Hofmann, University of Hamburg, 1994. UCI Machine Learning Repository.
license_and_access: Non-commercial research / educational use.
qualification_reason: Same provenance restrictions as DS004. Pre-encoded numeric features obscure original categorical semantics.

target_definition: Credit application decision: '+' = Application Approved (307), '-' = Application Rejected (383).
missing_values: Missing values encoded as '?' across 7 columns (37 total instances).
target_leakage_risks: All features anonymized and obfuscated to protect confidentiality (A1..A15).
suitability_notes: Unsuitable for credit default modeling: target is application approval/rejection, NOT loan repayment or default.
provenance: J. R. Quinlan, 1987. UCI Machine Learning Repository.
license_and_access: Public research use; commercial clearance unverified.
qualification_reason: Target is application underwriting approval, not credit default. Feature definitions are permanently obfuscated, making risk interpretation impossible.
